summary: The top-level page frame: canvas background, film-grain overlay, and a header bar.
purpose: Wrap every UnmessMe screen so the Midnight Terminal canvas, the noise texture, and the branded header are consistent. Reach for it as the outermost layout of any full page.

anatomy.description: Full-height background painted with the canvas token.
The UnmessMe wordmark on the left and header actions or an avatar on the right.
The centered, max-width content region that renders children.

props.name: children
props.description: The page content rendered inside the main region.

props.name: userAvatarUrl
props.description: Avatar image shown in the header when no headerActions are given.

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Custom right-side header content; replaces the avatar.

whenToUse: As the outermost wrapper of a full UnmessMe page, both marketing and app surfaces.
Anywhere the branded header and canvas background must be present.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Wrapping a nested section or a single content block
A focused overlay on top of the page

do: Use exactly one AppShell per screen, at the root.
Pass page-level nav or actions through headerActions.
dont: Nest an AppShell inside another AppShell.
Repaint the canvas background inside children; it is already set.

keyboard: Header actions are reachable in DOM order.
aria: Content region is a main landmark.
Noise overlay is decorative and non-interactive.
accessibility.contrast: Wordmark and header content hold at least 4.5:1 against the canvas.
accessibility.focus: No focus trap; this is page chrome, not a modal.

related.whenToChoose: Footer is site chrome placed inside AppShell content; AppShell is the whole-page frame.
Surface is a single panel inside the page; AppShell is the page itself.
